context.transcript:
Hi, May Lee.
We have a small problem.
It looks like we both booked Conference Room C for our 2 o'clock meetings today.
Oh, you know the room reservation software was updated last week.
My manager told me that there have been some problems with making room reservations ever since it was updated.
Okay, well, my meeting doesn't have to be today.
You can use the room and I'll move my meeting to tomorrow instead.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，May Lee。
我们有个小问题。
看起来我们俩都预订了今天下午两点的 C 会议室。
哦，你知道会议室预订软件上周更新了。
我的经理告诉我，自从它更新以来，预订会议室一直有些问题。
好的，我开会不一定非得是今天。
你可以用这个房间，我改到明天开会。
